description: Read-only MCP server for PakListings, the Pakistan business directory (183 cities, 24 categories). Search public businesses, read one business, list categories and cities. Free, no API key, 60 requests/minute per IP. Only fields already public on the listing pages are returned.
name: paklistings-mcp

tools.description: Search public PakListings businesses by keyword, city, or category. At most 20 results per call.

tools.description: List the 24 business categories covered by PakListings.
